title: Interesting and Easy Classical Poems
synopsis: You don’t have to speak perfect Chinese to learn about the culture. Learn some easy classical Chinese poems!

fullText.simplified:
有趣易学的古诗

    虽然很多外国朋友对中国文化都很感兴趣，但是大多数人觉得想要了解文化，应该先学好汉语。其实不是那样的。今天就给大家介绍中国传统文化中的一种——古诗，汉语零基础的朋友学起来也不难哦！
    第一首古诗：一去二三里，烟村四五家。亭台六七座，八九十枝花。
    这首诗写的是诗人春天出去玩的时候看到的美丽景色。意思是：“走到了离家两三里远的地方，看到了四五户人家。路边有六七个亭子，还开着十几枝花。”其中“里”是500米的意思；“烟村”的意思是村子里的房子；“亭台”就是小亭子。
    还有一首古诗是写雪的，也特别有意思。“一片两片三四片，五六七八九十片。千片万片无数片，飞入梅花总不见。”这首诗的意思也很简单，就是雪一片片落下来，越来越大，越来越多，最后都落进梅花里，因为梅花也是白色的，所以分不清什么是雪什么是花了。
    你瞧，这两首古诗都不难，而且很有意思。刚学汉语的朋友也可以明白。只要找到合适的学习材料，零基础也能学文化哦！
fullText.traditional:
有趣易學的古詩

    雖然很多外國朋友對中國文化都很感興趣，但是大多數人覺得想要了解文化，應該先學好漢語。其實不是那樣的。今天就給大家介紹中國傳統文化中的一種——古詩，漢語零基礎的朋友學起來也不難哦！
    第一首古詩：一去二三里，煙村四五家。亭臺六七座，八九十枝花。
    這首詩寫的是詩人春天出去玩的時候看到的美麗景色。意思是：“走到了離家兩三里遠的地方，看到了四五戶人家。路邊有六七個亭子，還開著十幾枝花。”其中“里”是500米的意思；“煙村”的意思是村子裡的房子；“亭臺”就是小亭子。
    還有一首古詩是寫雪的，也特別有意思。“一片兩片三四片，五六七八九十片。千片萬片無數片，飛入梅花總不見。”這首詩的意思也很簡單，就是雪一片片落下來，越來越大，越來越多，最後都落進梅花裡，因為梅花也是白色的，所以分不清什麼是雪什麼是花了。
    你瞧，這兩首古詩都不難，而且很有意思。剛學漢語的朋友也可以明白。只要找到合適的學習材料，零基礎也能學文化哦！

raw.synopsis: You don’t have to speak perfect Chinese to learn about the culture. Learn some easy classical Chinese poems!
sentence_translations: Interesting and Easy to Learn Classical Poems
Although many foreigners are very interested in Chinese culture, ..
.. a great majority of people think that if you want to understand the culture, you first have to master Chinese.
Actually, that’s not the case.
Today I’d like to introduce a type of traditional Chinese culture—classical Chinese poems.
They aren’t difficult to learn, even for people with no background in Chinese!
The first poem is, “A walk of two or three li, a misty village of four or five households.
Six or seven pavilions, eight, nine, ten flowers.”
This poem is about the beautiful scenery that the poet saw when he went out in spring.
It means, “After walking to a place that was two or three li away from home, I saw four or five households.
There were six or seven pavilions by the road, and also ten or so blooming flowers.”
“Li” means 500 meters, “yancun” refers to the houses in the village, and “tingtai” are small pavilions.
Here is another classical poem about snowfall which is also very interesting.
“One flake, two flakes, three, four flakes. Five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten flakes.
A thousand flakes, ten thousand flakes, countless flakes, they fly into plum blossoms and become completely invisible.”
The meaning of this poem is also very simple.
Snow is falling flake by flake, the flakes get bigger and bigger, and more and more flakes fall.
Finally, they all fall into plum blossoms.
Because plum blossoms are white too, you can’t differentiate what are snowflakes and what are plum blossoms.
As you can see, these two classical poems aren’t difficult at all, and also very interesting.
People who have just started to learn Chinese can also understand them.
As long as suitable study materials can be found, beginners can also learn about culture!
